doc.title: Jimmy Lewis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: Other bands and shows: Cootie Williams, Buddy Rich, Kate Smith, Billie Holiday film
summary: Lewis lists other work, including television with Buddy Rich, a Kate Smith show and films with Helen Humes and Billie Holiday.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Oh, man, so many, I didn’t even put them down, but you know, all the different bands I worked with and how I got to work in bands including Cootie Williams, Duke Ellington, a lot of bands. With Buddy Rich, I did a T.V. show with him, and we did shows with — what’s the name, the lady that used to sing [sings] when the moon comes over the mountain? Kate Smith. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-

Yeah we did a show with her. And we did all kinds of things, man. Made a movie with Helen Humes. And then we made another movie with Billie Holiday, that was nice, really nice. And then I did a lot more with just different people when I got back in New York.
